title: Split Curtailment on Farm Real Estate Loans: How the Homesite Is to Be Financed
content:
**The rule.** When a member asks to split the farmstead out of a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage, the paydown the member makes from their own funds includes, together with the shortfall, any split curtailment. A split curtailment is added to the paydown according to how the homesite is to be financed, figured on the release price at the product's release premium on the principal before the paydown: when the member has no Country Home loan application with the association on the homesite, the curtailment is 10 percent of that release price; when the member has such an application and the amount applied for is more than 80 percent of the homesite value stated in it, the curtailment is 5 percent of that release price; otherwise there is no curtailment. The curtailment is added to the shortfall before any rounding, and the sum of the two is rounded up to the next cent once; neither part is rounded on its own.

## Terms

- **Homesite** — the parcel of land use farmstead mortgaged to the loan; its parcel number is matched to the property parcel number of a Country Home loan application.
- **Country Home loan application** — an application with the association under Rural Home Loans, in applied status, on the homesite's parcel number; it states the amount applied for and the homesite value.
- **Release price for this purpose** — the product's release premium, times the principal balance before the paydown, times the homesite's appraised value at mortgage divided by the value still mortgaged; it is not rounded.

## Questions the rule answers

| Rural Home Loans application on the homesite | Amount applied for, share of stated value | Curtailment |
|---|---|---|
| none | — | 10 percent of the release price |
| yes | more than 80 percent | 5 percent of the release price |
| yes | 80 percent or less | none |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

Principal before the paydown USD 760000.00; homesite appraised at mortgage USD 250000 of USD 1000000 still mortgaged; release premium 115 percent. The release price for this purpose is 1.15 times 760000.00 times 0.25, that is 218500.00. Take a shortfall of 23157.894737 (an example input, unrounded).

| Homesite financing | Curtailment | Shortfall plus curtailment | Rounded up once |
|---|---|---|---|
| no application | 21850.00 | 45007.894737 | 45007.90 |
| application for 170000 on a stated value of 200000 (85 percent) | 10925.00 | 34082.894737 | 34082.90 |
| application for 160000 on a stated value of 200000 (exactly 80 percent) | none | 23157.894737 | 23157.90 |
